notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: That exercise does not exist. It may have been renamed.

hearing.levelsBlurb: Name the interval you hear. Pick a level, or set it up yourself.
hearing.setupBlurb: Name the interval you hear. One note is shown; the other appears with the answer.

reading.levelsBlurb: Name the interval written on the staff. Pick a level, or set it up yourself.

custom.title: Custom
custom.blurb: Set up exactly what you want to be asked.

direction.title: How it is played
direction.hint: Ascending and simultaneous intervals show their lower note first; descending ones show the upper note.

keySignatures.title: Key signatures
keySignatures.hint: The signature is drawn on the staff; notes may still take any accidental.

intervals.title: Intervals
intervals.hearingHint: Only intervals that sound different from one another. An augmented second is a minor third to the ear, so the ambiguous spellings are left to Interval Reading.

tonics.title: Tonics
tonics.hint: The note a scale starts from. Which ones are offered depends on the mode — a tonic that would need a double sharp is skipped.

scaleDirection.title: How it is played
scaleDirection.hint: The note you hear first is the note you see: the tonic going up, the octave above it coming down.

score.failed: The notation could not be drawn.

play.hint: Tap the notes to hear them

allCorrect.intervals: Every one correct. Try adding a clef, a key signature, or the augmented and diminished intervals.
allCorrect.scales: Every one correct. Try adding a mode, a tonic further round the circle, or the C clefs.
